lines: tt-a1i/archify has 77,286 GitHub stars. It turns any idea into a beautiful interactive diagram.
You want to see how your system works. Archify draws the map from your description.
Archify is an agent skill for Claude Code and others to turn code into diagrams.
Generate a typed JSON map, then validate it before rendering.
Use Archify to diagram a web request: Browser calls the API, the API checks Redis, and a cache miss queries PostgreSQL and fills the cache.
Open the repository to see the Proof Lab containing all 11 checked-in scenarios, their JSON sources, and validation receipts.
The Proof Lab holds 8–12 core components. Open the repo to see validation receipts.
It outputs a self-contained HTML file you can download and open in any browser.
Install with npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g. The output is standalone HTML.
Archify is MIT licensed, tested by users, with over 77,000 stars.
Save this for when you want to share your system diagram.
Archify turns your code into a standalone HTML diagram.
